newsitem.title: USA: NPC Q1 Pizza Hut restaurant revenue up.
newsitem.headline: NPC Q1 Pizza Hut restaurant revenue up.

text.p: NPC International Inc said revenue from its Pizza Hut operations totaled $80.8 million in the fiscal first quarter, up 48 percent from a year ago.
This increase was due to the acquisition of 312 restaurants since the same quarter of the prior year.
Comparable sales declined by 9.6 percent during the quarter due largely to a drop in "TripleDecker Pizza" sales.
Tony Roma's restaurant sales were $20.2 million for the quarter, up 24.4 percent. Net franchise revenue was $2.1 million in the quarter, which was essentially flat versus a year ago.
Earlier, NPC reported fiscal first quarter earnings of $0.23 a share, up from $0.22 a year ago.
"We expect continued improvement in the financial performance of the acquired units and improved comparable sales," Jim Schwartz, president, said in a statement.

NPC is the world's largest Pizza Hut franchisee and currently operates 695 Pizza Hut restaurants and delivery kitchens in 24 states. Through its Romacorp Inc unit, NPC operates and franchises 183 Tony Roma's restaurants.
